incident-bot: PAGE | Priority P1: degraded latency - dedicated pool eu-west-1 (capacity-node-set-7) — paging oncall-priya_oncall :rotating_light:

alex: Heads up — getting alerts for sustained p99 latency on dedicated GPU pool eu-west-1 since 06:12 UTC. Latency spikes > 2.5s for text-generation routes. Initial impact seen for LumenPay (acct 81234) and two integrations.

maria: seeing the same in observability. Errors are low but tail latency is through the roof. Traces show long kernel queues on node set 7.

priya_oncall: I'm on it. Looking at node set 7 now — mounting SSH and pulling vmstats.

priya_oncall: quick note — autoscaler didn't kick due to capacity cap on this dedicated pool. Opening a mitigation plan.

jeff: @priya_oncall if we need immediate relief we can fail traffic to hosted variants for high-touch customers. LumenPay contract requires we attempt a graceful failover first.

alex: list of potentially affected enterprise customers I have so far: LumenPay (acct 81234), Claricor Pay (acct 77691, integration via dedicated-rpc), BeaconHealth (acct 70921) — these have routes pinned to eu-west-1 dedicated. Confirming exact routing lists.

samir_cs: tagging in customer contacts. LumenPay primary engineering: maya@lumenpay.com, cc: ops@lumenpay.com. Claricor primary: d.jensen@claricor.com. BeaconHealth: nurseops@beaconhealth.org.

nora_am: I can notify LumenPay directly once we have impact text. They are high-touch; prefer a short targeted note + scheduled call.

priya_oncall: current mitigation steps (working):
- restart affected inference workers on node-set-7 (rolling, 1/3 to avoid cache loss)
- temporarily lift dedicated pool capacity cap to allow autoscaler burst + add 2 spare nodes
- if latency persists, fail traffic for pinned enterprise routes to hosted model variants in eu-west-1-hosted with token-preserving redirect

priya_oncall: running restart now — will update in ~2m.

incident-bot: deployment bot: rolling restart job queued: job-id 98432, started by priy


alex: If the second restart + added nodes doesn't bring p99 under 1s for affected tenant routes, plan B is to fail LumenPay pinned routes to hosted eu-west-1 variant. We will notify and perform failover with token preservation.

maria: preparing ephemeral dashboard for account-level tails so CS can confirm. Sharing link: https://observability.internal/redwood/ephemeral/1941200000

samir_cs: once we have confirmed improvement we will draft a concise customer follow-up: what happened, what we did, and any residual risk. Keep legal and compliance in the loop if data plane changed.
